details.prompt: ONE powerful claw sweep. 0-0.7s: shoulder and hips wind up, a thin readable red 140-degree wedge appears on the ground in front and fills toward its outer edge; feet brace. At 0.8s the torso drives the right hand in a low fast arc: exactly THREE short curved claw ribbons follow the three claw tips, bright warm ivory cores with restrained amber edges, different lengths, tapered three-dimensional curved surfaces, broken painterly texture and rapid dissolving tails. The claws scrape three shallow curved grooves in soil; a narrow fan of brown soil clods, bark chips and a few olive leaves bursts in the SAME direction. Brief concentrated flash only at ground contact. Warning wedge vanishes on contact. From 1.2s ribbons disappear while larger chips follow gravity and bounce once; recovery by 2s, dust and leaves settle through 4s. The visual focus is a crisp forceful three-claw strike, NOT a giant generic crescent, flat luminous circle, fire slash or screen-filling glow. No enemy target or blood.

details.prompt: ONE predatory leap, with the VFX focus ONLY on the launch. 0-0.8s: creature compresses low, both feet and claws grip the ground, several olive leaves loosen from shoulders. At 0.9s both legs drive an explosive push upward and forward; at the exact foot release a compact asymmetric backward-directed burst of chunky ochre soil, bark splinters and leaves erupts from the TWO foot contact points. A brief low dust roll hugs the launch point, two fresh shallow furrows remain. Use clear separation of a few large gravity-driven clods, medium bark chips and light fluttering leaves, with subtle spatial depth and restrained amber highlights. Creature follows one natural arc within frame and lands farther ahead around 1.6s with only a tiny plain dust puff; launch debris and leaves finish settling by 3s. Return to steady stance. No light beams, flames, magical propulsion, glowing circle, smoke blanket or continuous particle ribbon. The launch impulse must feel heavy, spring-loaded and rooted in physical contact.

details.prompt: ONE hunting pounce with the VFX focus on the LANDING and its warning. Creature crouches briefly and makes a short visible arc into a fixed landing location in front. From the first frame a crisp red danger mark lies flat on the earth at that fixed location: a thin legible outer boundary and three broad root-like lobes, translucent warm red fill visibly growing inward, subtle animated ember-red root strokes along the edge, uncluttered and no floating rune. The mark stays stationary and disappears precisely when both claws and feet land around 1.4s. At impact a sharp layered burst punches UP from the contact points: a dense low ochre dust core, several large irregular soil clods and wood splinters thrown on short ballistic arcs, a broken low radial dust skirt expanding along ground, light olive leaves trailing afterward. A tiny warm ivory impact accent lasts only an instant, never a fire explosion. Powerful compact initial 0.25s impact, body remains visible crouched taking the weight, dust opens quickly; chips bounce and settle through 3s, vulnerable recovery to 4s. No huge magical shockwave, no expanding dangerous red ring beyond the original mark, no sparks fountain, fire, or opaque smoke dome.

review_notes.title: Когтевой срез
review_notes.description: Светлые следы когтей, предупреждающий сектор, выброс земли по направлению удара. Для обсуждения: следы здесь сливаются в широкую дугу; в целевом эффекте нужно лучше различать три когтя.

review_notes.title: Отталкивание перед прыжком
review_notes.description: Выброс земли из-под опор и разлёт частиц при отталкивании. Отклонения генерации: лишние огненные всполохи и выход верхней части тела за кадр. Они не считаются утверждённым решением.

review_notes.title: Приземление
review_notes.description: Неподвижная красная метка, вертикальный выброс земли, низкая пыль и тяжёлые обломки. Для обсуждения: столб пыли великоват, а метка получилась знаком без нужного заполнения. Масштаб частиц и граница урона при реализации должны читаться отдельно.
